tables.name: cities
tables.label: Cities
tables.description: One row per modeled city — the single seeded feed for both the ranking cards and the embedded map. Append rows here to add more cities; nothing else needs to change.

tables.name: citymode
tables.label: City x mode
tables.description: One row per (city, mode) — mode in {all,bus,tram,subway,rail}. `all` rows carry the whole-network job-access ranking (transit_job_access_percapita etc, same numbers as the `cities` table); per-mode rows carry GTFS-derived NETWORK COVERAGE + FREQUENCY stats only (stops/routes/network_km/span_hrs/trips_per_hr_peak/median_headway_min/area_km2/stops_per_km2) — never a per-mode access/jobs number. Drives both the Ranking cards and the inline map via the board-level mode filter.
